main_text.p: bibat ægrè ad uncias fex, plus minusúe, prout ferre poterit in lecto,mediocriter te-ctus,atq; tum fudet. Omnia acida (ut fum-matim dicam)in hac fæuissima lue profli-ganda maximè conueniunt. Quibus ascri-buntur omphacium,berberis,ribes,uva cri-spa immatura,& alia id genus, quibus tum condimentorum, tum medicamentorum loco,liberè uti pofsimus.Ex his insuper sie ri possunt decocta addito pauco saccharo, quæ pro arbitrio bibere quauis hora ægro-tantibus licebit. Sunt & alia, quæ ob eximiam uim,quam aduersus uenenatos affe-ctus habent,minime negligenda sunt. Hu-ius classis habentur os cordis cerui, cornu cerui crudum,aut ustum,& in aqua rosacea sæpius perlotum : monocerotis cornu,co-rallium utrunq;,margarite,santalla omnia, præter flauum,cuius calorem insigniter in-nuit flagras odor. Idcirco uel pauca copia, uel refrigerantibus alijs admistum propi-nari debet. Sunt & alia propemodum infi-nita refrigerantia & exiccantia, quæ pesti-lentis morbi profligatione conuenire cre-duntur,ut heptaphyli radix, oxalidis folia, semina citrij,limonum,aranciorū & oxali-dis,quæ libens prætereo,quòd ab alijs me-dicis

page.notes: Catchword/signature: none printed. Several words are hyphenated at line ends; hyphens kept as printed. Long s is transcribed as plain s; the ligatures "sp"/"st" appear as printed. Last line "dicis" is set at the right and is the end of the paragraph's final word split across lines ("me-dicis"). Possible uncertain letters: "super sie" (line "super sie ri" may be "super sic"); "santalla" likely "santalla"; "uva cri-" appears as "uʃpa cri" in the scan and is read here as "uva cri-spa", the "uva" letters being partly obscured. Stains on the left edge are not transcribed. Marginal "er" in pencil at left top is handwriting and omitted.
